summary: Bộ sản phẩm văn phòng AI mã nguồn mở bao gồm Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF và Markdown/HTML editors, tích hợp AI agent và CLI để tạo/xử lý file cục bộ.
usecases: Free alternative to Microsoft Office with AI-assisted .docx, .xlsx, .pptx editing.
CLI and agent skills enabling Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code to create/automate office tasks locally.
Local-first PDF editing and conversion with built-in AI capabilities.
ideas: Offline AI suite integration with local LLMs (llama.cpp) for completely private document processing.
Plugin for design tools (Figma, Sketch) to export directly to genoffice formats via AI generation.
Automated daily report generation system triggered by schedule and powered by genoffice CLI.
